bola-reacao-verde.name: Green Reaction Ball
bola-reacao-verde.description: The ReaxOne Reaction Ball was developed to train reflexes, coordination and response speed. The irregular design guarantees unpredictable bounces for a more effective workout.

bola-reacao-verde-padel.name: Green Reaction Ball — Padel
bola-reacao-verde-padel.description: Developed specifically for padel training. Train your reaction time and improve hand-eye coordination on and off the court.

bola-reacao-branca.name: White Reaction Ball
bola-reacao-branca.description: The white version of our premium reaction ball. Ideal for indoor and outdoor training, with the same performance and durability as the green line.

bola-reacao-branca-pack.name: White Reaction Ball — Double Pack
bola-reacao-branca-pack.description: Pack with two white reaction balls. Ideal for training with a partner or always having one in reserve. Save 15% compared to individual purchase.

padel-sem-lesoes.name: Padel Without Injuries
padel-sem-lesoes.description: Your body is your best equipment. Train at home, play without fear. 8 weeks of physical training created by a Personal Trainer and Padel Coach to strengthen your body, prevent the most common padel injuries and improve your endurance — no gym, no equipment needed. Includes reaction training with ReaxOne® and scientific references in each chapter.

exercicios-para-beginners.name: Exercises for Beginners
exercicios-para-beginners.description: Your first step towards a more active life. Free guide with basic exercises for those just starting out — no equipment, no prior experience required. Includes reaction and coordination tips with ReaxOne®.
